## Decisions
- The device will be about 5 cm by 10 cm, which the ID confirmed is feasible [00:21:40]
- A small LCD will be used instead of the full 7-inch screen [00:22:26]
- The shape will be a modified, somewhat fatter banana [00:25:09]
- The remote will use infrared [00:25:24]
- Speech recognition will be included [00:31:49]

## Action items
- ID: Work on the look and feel design [00:32:18]
- UI: Work on the user interface design [00:32:30]
- ME: Do the first project evaluation [00:32:41]
- ID and UI: Work together on a first prototype, including the shape and how to fit all components together [00:32:56]
- owner not assigned: Send the ID the preferred 5×10 dimensions [00:22:28]
- ID: Work out the board design to fit 5×10 [00:22:35]

## Unresolved
- How to prioritise: ME ranks fancy look first, while UI thinks easy to use matters more [00:06:04]
- Whether to use a shaped screen (ME's preference) or a square one (cheaper, four screens per panel) [00:24:44]
- Whether solar cells will get enough light indoors [00:18:52]
- Where to put the solar cell relative to the peelable cover, and whether a window is needed [00:31:05]
- Whether hidden buttons under a soft, peelable "banana skin" cover are technically possible; the ID can't yet picture it [00:27:42]
- How to attach the cover: Velcro or magnetic [00:28:50]
- What the outer layer should be made of, e.g. vinyl with a suede feel [00:30:01]
